solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total calories

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power for weightlifting competition in 6 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed across the day with at least 2.0g protein per kg bodyweight (170g minimum)

Plan is presented as a single day format with specific food items and portion sizes
All meals are practical and realistic for a single athlete to prepare
